description: Dated closing prices and volumes for each researched stock. From 2 Oct to 13 Nov 2026 every close, volume, trades and value figure is NGX official, taken on 16 Nov 2026 from NGX's Daily Official List and price lists with the ngxprices tool (30 Oct from NGX's Daily Summary, the only file NGX published that day; it has no value traded). NGX published no files at all for 5 Nov, so 5 Nov keeps the Mansa Markets board figures. Fifteen closes were corrected (each corrected row has a note with the old figure), including Okomu Oil 11 Nov (₦1,148.60 official, down 10.0%; the earlier ₦1,137.10 was wrong) and UPDC REIT 28-30 Oct (₦21.10, not ₦19.25). Linkage Assurance's 13 Nov volume of 3,102,325,900 shares is confirmed by NGX (44 trades, ₦3.72bn, likely one negotiated block). Points before 2 Oct come from news and NGX price lists and their volumes may be undercounted. Seplat's 13 Nov close (₦16,241.90) is ex-dividend.
